Question Choices: Select all objects whose lengths are conveniently measured in meters: ~~eraser | car | finger | swimming-pool~~
Solution: Both a car and a swimming pool are conveniently measured in meters. An eraser and finger are much smaller and are usually measured in centimeters. Select car and swimming-pool.

Question Choices: Select which unit would probably be used to measure how long a park is ~~Meters | Centimeters~~
Solution: A park is a large space. Meters are a more convenient unit than centimeters.

Question Choices: Select which unit would probably be used to measure how long a table is ~~Inches | Feet~~
Solution: A table is several feet long, so feet are the more convenient choice for its length.

Question Choices: Select which you would measure in centimeters ~~paperclip | tree | building | football-field~~
Solution: A paperclip is small, so centimeters are convenient. The tree, building and field are much larger.

Question Choices: Select which is closest to how long a belt is ~~80-centimeters | 80-meters~~
Solution: A belt can be about 80 centimeters long. Eighty meters is far too long for a belt.
